ReleaseOrchBot: :rocket: Starting prod rollout (us-west-2) — rollout_id=r-2026-03-20-01. Strategy: progressive by AZ, canary in eu-west-1 first. Expected 12m.
ReleaseOrchBot: Payload: model-service@7f3a2b1 (tag: v1.14.0), infra-config@d9c8b2e. Commits/PRs: ```
7f3a2b1 — Maria — PR #422 — /repo/model-service/pull/422
d9c8b2e — Priya — PR #518 — /repo/infra-config/pull/518
3c5b9f0 — Jake — PR #400 — /repo/runtime/pull/400
```
Jake: Copying commit list to the thread, thx. Any authors we should ping for canary monitoring?
Maria: I'm watching the model-service canary. PR #422 touched the KV cache invalidation path — keeping an eye on latency regressions.
Priya: infra-config change is a small nginx tweak for header handling, low risk.
Ashley: FYI our integration e2e in staging showed an intermittent flake on the auth proxy yesterday — might be unrelated but flagging in case prod canary surfaces it.
Jake: Which test flaked? auth-proxy or routing? If auth-proxy, that maps to PR #387 which is not in this deploy.
Ashley: It was auth-proxy session test, see CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/1234 — failure only twice in 48h.
ReleaseOrchBot: Canary started in eu-west-1 — 10% traffic. Health checks passing. Metrics: p50 latency +2ms, error rate 0.02%.
Maria: Seeing a small spike in KV cache miss rate at +10s after request bursts, but no errors. Continuing to monitor.
Priya: infra logs look clean. No 5xx from nginx.
Jake: If the auth-proxy flake appears we should consider pinning model-service to prior SHA 6e2a1cd for the rest of the rollout. That one passed our extended regression harness yesterday.
Ashley: Agree. Plan B: pause rollout, promote 6e2a1cd to prod, run a targeted smoke against auth flows. Need ack from release lead.
Priya: How long do we let the canary run before decision? Current telemetry window is 15m per policy.
Jake: Let's set a hard 12-minute check for this rollout — if error rate >0.1% or auth-related 5xx observed, we pause and pin.
ReleaseOrchBot: Noted. Auto-pause rule set: error_rate>0.1% OR auth_5xx>0.01% during canary window. Will notify on trigger.
InfraOnCallBot: @InfraOnCallBot set to alert on auth_5xx anomalies at +30s.
Ashley: @Jake @Maria I'll take ownership of the rollback/pin path if we need it. Can someone draft the exact rollback command?
Priya: Rollback command (promo previous SHA): ```
deploy orchestrator promote --env prod --from-sha 6e2a1cd --to-sha 6e2a1cd --rollout-id r-2026-03-20-01 --reason "pin due to auth-proxy flake"
```
Maria: If we pin, also disable auto-scaling burst for 10m to avoid noisy neighbors during the transition.
Jake: Sounds good. @ReleaseOrchBot add annotation to rollout: "watch-auth-proxy" and tag owners Maria/Ashley.
ReleaseOrchBot: Annotation applied. Owners: Maria, Ashley.
ReleaseOrchBot: Canary complete in eu-west-1. No auth_5xx observed. Proceeding to us-west-2 AZ1 with 25% traffic.
Maria: Monitoring — latency stable, KV miss normalized.
Ashley: Running targeted smoke for session auth now — all green so far.
Priya: Rolling to remaining AZs. ETA 8m.
ReleaseOrchBot: Prod rollout finished. All AZs healthy. Final SHAs: model-service@7f3a2b1, infra-config@d9c8b2e. Release notes URL: https://releases.redwood.dev/r-2026-03-20-01
Jake: Nice one. Thanks all for the quick checks. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll leave a follow-up in the release notes re: KV cache telemetry and the decision threshold.
Ashley: Marking post-deploy eval for tomorrow morning.
ReleaseOrchBot: Rollout closed: status=success, duration=11m36s, pinned=false.
